summary: TOP Ships Inc., a Greek-incorporated foreign private issuer listed on NYSE American, furnished a Form 6-K attaching a September 22, 2026 press release responding to unusual post-market trading September 21 and pre-market activity September 22, issued under Section 401(d) of the NYSE American Company Guide. Management states inquiries found no conditions requiring corrective action and no undisclosed material development explaining the move. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. Not a special situation; this is an exchange-requested unusual-activity response, leaving no deal mechanics or regulatory clock to track.
